view_definition:
SELECT id,
    tenant_id,
    load_id,
    order_id,
    fiscal_document_id,
    item_description,
    quantity,
    pallet_count,
    weight_kg,
    volume_m3,
    status,
    notes,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    delivery_attempt_id,
    source_delivery_item_id
   FROM load_items i
  WHERE fiscal_document_id IS NULL OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM fiscal_documents f
          WHERE f.id = i.fiscal_document_id AND NOT f.current_delivery_attempt_id IS DISTINCT FROM i.delivery_attempt_id));
